summary: MSP Recovery, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting a $0.2 million one-time discretionary advance under its existing working capital credit facility with Hazel Partners Holdings LLC. The advance was made solely at Hazel's discretion on June 26, 2026, for operating expenses, with no commitment or minimum availability. This is a routine capital infusion, not a special situation. No deal terms, premium, or structural changes are involved.
